about_the_game:
One World. One Month. One Community.

A top-down action where exploration is collective, secrets are shared, and every month brings a brand-new procedurally generated world for all players to uncover—together.

Monthly Shared World

Each month, a fresh world is generated and synced across all players. Whether you're the first to stumble upon a hidden boss or the hundredth to crack a cryptic puzzle, your discoveries fuel a living, breathing community of adventurers. Share maps, theories, and secrets as you collectively unravel the mysteries of the current cycle.

Eea awaits you

From cryptic lore to hidden mechanics, The isle of Eea rewards those who dig deeper and collaborate. Whether you're a solo sleuth or a forum fanatic, there's always something new to uncover.

Three Ways to Play

  • Community World Mode: Dive into the monthly shared world and explore at your own pace. Secrets persist, but your journey is uniquely yours.

  • Roguelike Mode: One life. One run. Die and the world resets.

  • Gauntlet Mode: Face relentless waves of enemies in room-by-room combat. No exploration—just pure survival until your last breath.
